title: GE Profile — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for GE Profile.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Make It You." Premium tier. GE Profile is the premium tier of GE Appliances — smarter features, better finishes, and design-forward styling. The Fingerprint Resistant stainless is standard, No-Preheat Air Fry saves time, and everything connects via the SmartHQ app. Profile sits between base GE and ultra-premium Monogram.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers stepping up from base GE or competing mid-range brands. Kitchen remodels wanting smart features without luxury pricing.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for GE Profile:

• No-Preheat Air Fry — oven is ready instantly, no waiting

• Fingerprint Resistant finish standard on everything — stainless without the smudges

• SmartHQ app controls all appliances from your phone

• Hands-free AutoFill on refrigerators dispenses exact measured amounts

• Premium design at mid-range pricing — looks like luxury without the price tag
